title: Multiscale modeling for problems with high contrast heterogeneous coefficients by the CEM-GMsFEM
summary: This review paper provides a comprehensive overview of the Constrained Energy Minimizing Generalized Multiscale Finite Element Method (CEM-GMsFEM) for solving elliptic PDEs characterized by highly heterogeneous, high-contrast coefficients. We detail the construction of multiscale basis functions via spectral auxiliary spaces, combined with an oversampling strategy that enables localized computations and guarantees exponential error decay.
